descriptions.en: IT Map element-card presentation profiles and relation slots. Depends on kc-base and archimate-lite. Not part of knowledge-core.
descriptions.cs: IT Map prezentační profily karet elementů a relation slots. Závisí na kc-base a archimate-lite. Není součástí jádra knowledge-core.

descriptions.en: Not an ArchiMate concept. Root for IT Map element-card presentation metadata.
descriptions.cs: Není ArchiMate koncept. Kořen metadat IT Map karet elementů.

classes.usageGuidance: Root for card presentation profile data. Not used in architecture diagrams.

descriptions.en: Domain presentation of an ArchiMate element type for the IT Map card UI.

classes.usageGuidance: Maps a domain concept (e.g. Oddělení) to an ArchiMate class plus match properties. Does not invent new architecture semantics.
classes.usageExamples: department → BusinessActor with actorKind=organizationalUnit and organizationScope=internal.

descriptions.en: One card section for inbound or outbound relationships of a presentation profile.

classes.usageGuidance: Declares which ArchiMate relationship and direction appear on the card, with a domain label. Must stay within AllowedRelationship.

descriptions.en: Stable code identifying a presentation profile.
descriptions.cs: Stabilní kód identifikující prezentační profil.

properties.usageGuidance: Unique code within the cards package.

descriptions.en: Semantic version of the presentation profile content.
descriptions.cs: Sémantická verze obsahu prezentačního profilu.

descriptions.en: Minimum archimate-lite catalog version required by this profile.
descriptions.cs: Minimální verze katalogu archimate-lite vyžadovaná tímto profilem.

descriptions.en: True for seeded system presentation profiles in archimate-ui-cards.
descriptions.cs: True u seedovaných systémových prezentačních profilů v archimate-ui-cards.

descriptions.en: iriLocal of the ArchiMate element class this profile presents.
descriptions.cs: iriLocal třídy ArchiMate elementu, kterou profil prezentuje.

properties.usageGuidance: Must be an archimate-lite element class local name.

descriptions.en: JSON object of property local → value that must all match for profile resolution.
descriptions.cs: JSON objekt property local → hodnota; všechny musí sedět pro resoluci profilu.

properties.usageGuidance: JSON whitelist of instance property values.

descriptions.en: CSV of AML property iriLocals to show on the card (labels from schema).
descriptions.cs: CSV iriLocal AML properties zobrazených na kartě (labely ze schema).

properties.usageGuidance: References only; do not redefine datatypes or enums.

descriptions.en: Czech domain name of the presentation profile.
descriptions.cs: Český doménový název prezentačního profilu.

properties.usageGuidance: Shown as the card type title.

descriptions.en: English domain name of the presentation profile.
descriptions.cs: Anglický doménový název prezentačního profilu.

descriptions.en: Display order among profiles or slots.
descriptions.cs: Pořadí zobrazení mezi profily nebo sloty.

descriptions.en: Stable code of the relation slot within its profile.
descriptions.cs: Stabilní kód relation slotu v rámci profilu.

descriptions.en: Owning PresentationProfile for this relation slot.
descriptions.cs: Vlastnící PresentationProfile tohoto relation slotu.

descriptions.en: Domain label for the card section (not the ArchiMate relationship name).
descriptions.cs: Doménový label sekce na kartě (ne název ArchiMate vztahu).

descriptions.en: iriLocal of the ArchiMate relationship class.
descriptions.cs: iriLocal třídy ArchiMate vztahu.

properties.usageGuidance: Must be an archimate-lite relationship class.

descriptions.en: Whether the slot follows outgoing (source→target) or incoming (target←source) edges from the card subject.
descriptions.cs: Zda slot sleduje odchozí (source→target) nebo příchozí (target←source) hrany od subjektu karty.

properties.usageGuidance: outgoing = subject is relationship source; incoming = subject is relationship target.

descriptions.en: CSV of allowed neighbor ArchiMate element class locals.
descriptions.cs: CSV povolených tříd sousedních ArchiMate elementů.

descriptions.en: CSV of presentation profile codes the neighbor should resolve to.
descriptions.cs: CSV kódů prezentačních profilů, na které by soused měl resolvovat.

properties.usageGuidance: Optional soft filter after profile resolution of neighbors.

descriptions.en: Whether an empty slot is shown by default (recommended) or only when filled / in expert mode (optional).
descriptions.cs: Zda se prázdný slot zobrazí defaultně (recommended) nebo jen vyplněný / v expert režimu (optional).

properties.usageGuidance: recommended slots show empty placeholders; optional hide when empty unless expert.
